params.name: paymentType
params.description: Returns payments of this Payment Type. It is possible to filter by multiple values by repeating this argument.

params.name: merchantReference
params.description: Returns transactions of the payments associated with this merchant reference.

params.name: authorization.status
params.description: Returns transactions of the payments at this payment Authorization Status.

params.name: verification.status
params.description: Returns transactions of the payments at this payment Verification Status.

params.name: paymentId
params.description: Returns payments of this identification.

params.name: merchant.merchantId
params.description: Returns payments by this merchant identification.

params.name: description
params.description: Returns payments by description.

params.name: paymentProvider.paymentProviderId
params.description: Returns payments by this payment provider identification.

params.name: customer.customerId
params.description: Returns payments by this customer identification.

params.name: fingerprint
params.description: Returns payments by this fingerprint.

params.name: createdAt.start
params.description: Returns payments after this creation date

params.name: createdAt.end
params.description: Returns payments before this creation date

params.name: updatedAt.start
params.description: Returns payments after this update date

params.name: updatedAt.end
params.description: Returns payments before this update date

params.name: amount.min
params.description: Returns payments for that minimum amount.

params.name: amount.max
params.description: Returns payments for that maximum amount.

params.name: paid.min
params.description: Returns payments for that minimum paid.

params.name: paid.max
params.description: Returns payments for that maximum paid.

params.name: refunded.min
params.description: Returns payments with this minimum refund amount.

params.name: refunded.max
params.description: Returns payments with this maximum refund amount.

params.name: orderBy
params.description: List payments by order field.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Returns payments by this sort order

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Returns payments from that offset

params.name: count
params.description: Returns the maximum number of payments specified by this field

items.docs: Returns a list of transactions. It can be paged and filtered by appending arguments to the query string of the request.

params.name: paymentId
params.description: The identifier of the payment object to be retrieved.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a Payment. Supply the unique paymentId that was returned from your previous request, and Trustly will return the corresponding payment information.
